# Phase 6 — Final File Plan

> One light, many keilim; one timeline, many faces;
> the Awtsmoos lets each studio reveal the features fitting its places.

## New shared core
- `shared/movie/core/MovieKinds.js` — semantic kinds and dimensional modes.
- `shared/movie/core/MovieIds.js` — deterministic safe IDs.
- `shared/movie/core/MovieProjectFactory.js` — normalized project/scene/entity creation.
- `shared/movie/core/MovieProjectValidator.js` — timing/shape/feature validation.
- `shared/movie/core/MovieCapabilities.js` — per-app feature contracts and negotiation.
- `shared/movie/ai/MovieIntentCompiler.js` — structured AI intent to a real project.
- `shared/movie/ai/MovieDirector.js` — genre/tutorial/infographic/cinematic scene expansion.
- `shared/movie/adapters/ProjectionReport.js` — truthful fidelity accounting.
- `shared/movie/index.js` — public shared surface.

## New app bridges
- `apps/animator/src/sharedMovie/AnimatorMovieAdapter.js` — shared project to existing Animator movie-plan grammar.
- `apps/nesher-studio/modules/movie/NesherMovieAdapter.js` — shared project to NLE tracks/clips.
- `apps/video-editor/js/movie/VideoEditorMovieAdapter.js` — shared project to lightweight clip records.
- `apps/mitzvah-studio/modules/movie/MitzvahMovieAdapter.js` — shared scene entities to `awtsmoos.world.v1`.

## Three-minute proof
- `apps/animator/src/scenes/awtsmoosThreeMinute/AwtsmoosThreeMinuteIntent.js` — rich declarative intent.
- `apps/animator/src/scenes/AwtsmoosThreeMinuteMovie.js` — creates and adapts the 180000ms project.
- `apps/animator/tools/verify/verifyAwtsmoosThreeMinuteMovie.js` — project/adapter acceptance proof.

## Integration approach
First prove imports and adapters. Then inspect stable UI/boot seams and wire shared AI generation only with hash-guarded whole-file rewrites. Never overwrite live concurrent UI work merely to expose a button.
